chunks: “The time of the morning prayer is when the dawn spreads across horizontally and gives a good light.”

key_terms.الْغَدَاةِ: the morning, referring here to the Fajr prayer time
key_terms.الْفَجْرُ: the dawn, specifically the true dawn marking the start of Fajr
key_terms.حَسَنًا: clearly and well, indicating distinct visible light
key_terms.وَقْتَ: the appointed time or beginning of an act of worship

ai.seo_question: When does the time of Fajr begin according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the time of Fajr begins with the appearance of true dawn as it spreads across the horizon and its light becomes clear. It is significant for identifying the proper beginning time of the morning salat (prayer).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "The time of Fajr (morning prayer) begins when the true dawn appears and spreads light horizontally in a good way”.
